# Hindustan Electricals Winding Works

> Hindustan Electricals Winding Works is a motor rewinding and electrical motor repair workshop in GIDC Vapi, Gujarat. The business provides motor rewinding, AC/DC motor winding, electric motor repair, generator repair, transformer repair and welding machine repair for industrial and commercial customers across Vapi, Silvassa, Daman, Valsad and Pardi.
